Very happy with Dhruva. From the beginning, his attention to detail stood out, and he went above and beyond to accommodate our ideas, preferences, and even the smallest of requests. He was incredibly patient and made sure our vision came to life as we had imagined.

He must be commended for his professionalism—he was always punctual, respected our time, and ensured the project was delivered as per the agreed timelines. He also made a sincere effort to stay within the budget, which we greatly appreciated.

What really sets him apart is his commitment even after the project is complete. It has been two years since our home was done, and his after-sales service continues to be excellent. He is responsive, proactive, and clearly values long-term relationships with his clients.

He is an excellent architect and paired with the right turnkey contractor, he can deliver your vision. We are extremely happy and would highly recommend him!

featured_reviews.review_text:

The entire staff - from masons, carpenters, electricians to plumbers and painters - were sincere, soft spoken and professional.

I highly recommend working with Dhruv Samal for any project you have in mind. They truly exceeded my expectations in every way possible.

Throughout the entire design and construction process, Dhruv was readily available to answer any questions or address any concerns that arose. They were highly organized and efficient, which made the entire process run smoothly and effectively.

The end result of working with Dhruv is a beautiful and functional space that I absolutely love. I have received countless compliments from friends and family on the design, and I am confident that the value of my property has increased significantly because of their work.
